Sabaragamuwa Province Library Services Board (Amendment) Statute No. 02 of 1998
A statute to amend the Sabaragamuwa Province Library Services Board Statute No. 02 of 1998.
Be it enacted by the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lankaas follows
1. This statute may be cited as the Sabaragamuwa Proivnce Library Services Board (amendement)
Statute No. ........ of 2014 and shall come into operation on such date as the Governor of theSabaragramuwa Province may appoint.
2. Section 11 of the Sabaragamuwa Province Library Services Board Statute No. 02 of 1998

(hereinafter referred to as the principal statute) is hereby amended by adding the words“Should pay some allowance to the board members” instead of the words “Should not paysome allowance to the board members”
3. In case of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Statute, Sinhala text
shall prevail.

A statute to provide for the services of the financial year 2015 to authorize the raising of loans within theprovince of Sabaragamuwa for the purpose of such service, to make financial provisions in respect ofcertain activities of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council during the financial year, to enable the payment,by way of advances out of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund of any other fund or monies of,or at the disposal of, the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund, and to make provision for mattersconnected with or incidental to the aforesaid matter.
